messages.content: What are the latest movie releases?

function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data on current movie releases. If you let me know what kind of movies you’re interested in (genre, language, region, etc.) I can suggest some recent titles that were popular around the time of my last update, or I can point you toward resources where you can find the most up‑to‑date release information.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What are the latest movie releases?" We have no browsing tool. We cannot fetch real-time data. According to policy, we should respond with uncertainty and ask for clarification or provide general info. We can say we don't have up-to-date info.
